secure_aggregation.protocol: Pairwise Additive Masking (Bonawitz et al. SecAgg Protocol)
secure_aggregation.security_property: Individual client parameters are zero-sum masked; aggregator observes ONLY the sum.
secure_aggregation.production_distinction: Simulation assumes synchronous participation without dropouts. Production SecAgg incorporates threshold Shamir secret sharing to reconstruct masks of dropped clients.

threat_model.assumption: Adversary controls client update vector but does not compromise the server aggregation protocol.

defense_effectiveness.conclusion: Standard FedAvg is vulnerable to gradient/parameter poisoning. Coordinate-wise Trimmed Mean successfully rejects the outlier adversarial vector, preserving model utility.
